subject.title: feat(ios): redesign Control tab to a flatter, card-based layout

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this flatter iPhone Control tab layout with prominent Chat/Talk cards as the default direction once the branch is rebased and proven?
rationale: This is a user-visible visual/product direction change for the default iOS Control tab, and tests can verify mechanics but cannot choose the desired design hierarchy.

options.title: Require rebased visual proof first
options.body: Ask for a rebase that preserves current main behavior, fixes branded typography, and adds before/after simulator proof before making the design call.

options.title: Accept the design direction
options.body: After the mechanical blockers are fixed, maintainers can decide the flatter Chat/Talk-card Control hub should become the iPhone baseline.

options.title: Narrow or decline the redesign
options.body: Keep the current native List hub or ask for a narrower follow-up if the proposed hierarchy is not the desired iOS direction.

recommendation.title: Require rebased visual proof first
recommendation.body: Ask for a rebase that preserves current main behavior, fixes branded typography, and adds before/after simulator proof before making the design call.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the overlapping Control/Talk visual hierarchy and Control-detail routing repairs and are the strongest current-history owner for this product decision.
